highlights: sold by modern method of auction
summary: BEING SOLD BY MODERN METHOD OF AUCTION Set within the heart of the picturesque and highly desirable village of Bowes, this stunning barn conversion enjoys an enviable position just outside the historic market town of Barnard Castle.
description:
MODERN METHOD OF AUCTION TERMS This property is for sale by the Modern Method of Auction, meaning the buyer and seller are to Complete within 56 days (the "Reservation Period"). Interested parties personal data will be shared with the Auctioneer (iamsold). If considering buying with a mortgage, inspect and consider the property carefully with your lender before bidding. A Buyer Information Pack is provided. The winning bidder will pay £349.00 including VAT for this pack which you must view before bidding. The buyer signs a Reservation Agreement and makes payment of a non-refundable Reservation Fee of 4.5% of the purchase price including VAT, subject to a minimum of £6,600.00 including VAT. This is paid to reserve the property to the buyer during the Reservation Period and is paid in addition to the purchase price. This is considered within calculations for Stamp Duty Land Tax. Services may be recommended by the Agent or Auctioneer in which they will receive payment from the service provider if the service is taken. Payment varies but will be no more than £450.00. These services are optional.

Surrounded by beautiful countryside, Bowes offers a charming village atmosphere with a strong sense of community, complemented by a traditional village pub, primary school, and church hall - making it an ideal location for those seeking a peaceful yet well-connected lifestyle. This beautifully presented and spacious home is a true turnkey property, offering all the benefits of semi-rural living while remaining within easy commuting distance of neighbouring towns and transport links. The barn has been thoughtfully and comprehensively renovated to an exceptional standard, blending contemporary design with the careful preservation of original character features, resulting in a home that is both stylish and rich in charm. The accommodation is arranged over two floors and has been designed to offer both generous proportions and a flexible layout. The ground floor comprises a welcoming entrance porch providing access to a convenient ground-floor WC and leading into the main hallway, a striking kitchen/breakfast room ideal for everyday living, a formal dining room perfect for entertaining, a spacious main lounge offering a cosy retreat, and a rear porch providing additional practicality. To the first floor, there are four well-appointed bedrooms, all offering comfortable and versatile accommodation, along with a family bathroom finished to a high standard. The layout lends itself perfectly to family life, guest accommodation, or home-working requirements. Externally, the property benefits from a secluded and private garden area, creating a peaceful outdoor space for relaxation and entertaining, along with off-road parking. Offered to the market with no onward chain, this exceptional barn conversion must be viewed to fully appreciate the quality, character, and lifestyle it offers.

ENTRANCE PORCH A bright and inviting entrance porch, accessed via a UPVC-framed double-glazed door, complemented by a UPVC-framed sash-style window that floods the space with natural light. The porch features elegant flooring and a radiator, creating a warm and welcoming environment. Inset ceiling spotlights provide a modern touch, while internal doors lead to the ground-floor WC and the main hallway, offering practical access and a seamless transition into the home's living spaces. The porch sets the tone for the property, blending functionality with character and charm.

HALLWAY

A welcoming and practical space that provides stairs access to the first floor, enhanced by inset ceiling spotlights which illuminate the area with a modern touch. The hallway acts as a central hub, connecting the entrance porch to the ground-floor living spaces while maintaining a sense of openness and flow throughout the home.

LOUNGE A generously proportioned and beautifully appointed reception room, the lounge exudes both warmth and character. At its heart sits a striking inglenook fireplace with a log-burning stove, complete with a feature sleeper beam over and a tiled hearth, creating a captivating focal point that blends rustic charm with contemporary comfort. Inset ceiling spotlights illuminate the room, highlighting the natural textures and architectural details. A UPVC-framed double-glazed window provides abundant natural light and views to the front garden, while a door gives access to the front exterior. Additional internal doors lead seamlessly to the rear porch and dining room, enhancing the sense of flow and connectivity throughout the ground floor. This room is perfectly suited for both relaxed family living and elegant entertaining.

DINING ROOM An elegantly proportioned and inviting space, perfectly designed for entertaining or family gatherings. The room is illuminated by a UPVC-framed double-glazed sash-style window, which allows soft natural light to fill the space, highlighting the room's character and warmth. Inset ceiling spotlights provide subtle, modern illumination, while a radiator ensures the room remains cosy throughout the year. The generous layout offers ample space for a substantial dining table and chairs, along with additional furniture such as display cabinets or sideboards, creating a versatile room that seamlessly combines functionality with style. Its positioning adjacent to both the lounge and kitchen ensures a natural flow, ideal for entertaining and everyday living.

KITCHEN/BREAKFAST ROOM This newly appointed kitchen is a striking blend of contemporary style and rustic character, offering a spacious and versatile heart to the home. A range of fitted base and wall units is complemented by elegant work surfaces with contrasting splashbacks, providing ample storage and a practical workspace. The inset sink with drainer and mixer tap is perfectly positioned, while integrated appliances include a modern oven and hob with a stainless steel chimney-style extractor unit, combining efficiency with sleek design. A double larder cupboard cleverly houses the central heating boiler and provides additional storage, while the room's character is enhanced by a feature inglenook fireplace, adding warmth and a sense of history. Practical elements include plumbing for an automatic washing machine and a radiator for comfort. Natural light fills the space, highlighting its charming details, while a door leads seamlessly to the utility area, creating a practical flow for household tasks. This kitchen/breakfast room is not only highly functional but also a welcoming space for family dining, casual meals, or social gatherings, perfectly marrying contemporary convenience with the unique character of this barn conversion.

UTILITY ROOM A practical area, the utility space features inset ceiling lights providing bright, even illumination and electrical points for appliances or additional equipment. This versatile space offers convenient functionality for laundry, storage, or household tasks, complementing the kitchen and overall flow of the ground floor.

GARDEN ROOM

A bright and practical addition to the home, the rear garden room features UPVC-framed double-glazed windows that allow natural light to flood the space and offer views of the secluded garden. A UPVC-framed door provides direct access to the outdoor area, while the flooring adds a durable and easy-to-maintain finish. This versatile space is ideal for casual seating, storage, or as a transitional area between the home and garden.

GROUND FLOOR WC A convenient and thoughtfully designed space, the ground-floor WC features a fitted white suite, comprising a WC and a wash hand basin set into a vanity unit, providing both functionality and storage. Inset ceiling spotlights illuminate the room, while a UPVC-framed double-glazed window allows natural light to fill the space. The flooring adds a practical and stylish finish, creating a modern and inviting WC suitable for both family use and guests.

FIRST FLOOR LANDING A bright and welcoming space, the first-floor landing features a UPVC-framed double-glazed window, allowing natural light to fill the area. Feature ceiling beams add character and a sense of rustic charm, while inset ceiling spotlights provide modern, ambient lighting. The landing offers door access to all four bedrooms and the family bathroom, serving as a central hub for the upper floor and maintaining a seamless flow between rooms.

BEDROOM ONE A beautifully spacious and characterful double bedroom, Bedroom One perfectly blends rustic charm with modern functionality. The room features a range of built-in robes, providing excellent storage while maintaining a clean and uncluttered aesthetic. Feature ceiling beams enhance the barn conversion character, adding warmth and architectural interest. A radiator ensures the room remains cosy, and a UPVC-framed double-glazed stable door with window fills the space with natural light while offering private access to the exterior, creating a seamless connection between indoor and outdoor living. This bedroom is both a tranquil retreat and a versatile space for relaxation or dressing.

BEDROOM TWO A versatile and well-proportioned room, Bedroom Two features a UPVC-framed double-glazed sash window that allows natural light to fill the space, complemented by inset ceiling spotlights for modern illumination. A radiator provides warmth, and the room is currently utilised as a home office, making it ideal for flexible use such as a study, guest bedroom, or additional living space. The generous proportions and neutral décor provide a comfortable and functional environment.

BEDROOM THREE A generously proportioned double bedroom, Bedroom Three combines space, light, and character. It features a UPVC-framed double-glazed window that fills the room with natural light, feature ceiling beams that add rustic charm, and inset ceiling spotlights providing modern, ambient illumination. A radiator ensures comfort, making this a versatile and inviting bedroom suitable for family, guests, or flexible living arrangements.

BEDROOM FOUR A generously sized double bedroom, Bedroom Four offers abundant space for furniture and versatile layouts, making it suitable for family use, a guest room, or a home office. A UPVC-framed double-glazed sash-style window fills the room with natural light, highlighting the feature ceiling beams that add rustic character and architectural interest. Inset ceiling spotlights provide modern, ambient illumination, while a radiator ensures warmth and comfort throughout the year. The combination of light, space, and character makes this a highly adaptable and inviting room within the barn conversion.

FAMILY BATHROOM A luxurious, spa-inspired retreat, the family bathroom is designed for both relaxation and style. It features a freestanding roll-top bath, ideal for indulgent soaks, complemented by a wash hand basin set into a bespoke vanity unit and a WC, providing seamless storage and a streamlined finish. A generously sized shower enclosure boasts an inset mains-fed rainhead shower with an additional handheld attachment, combining contemporary convenience with indulgent functionality. The room is adorned with part-tiled walls around splash and vanity areas, perfectly blending elegance and practicality, while a chrome contemporary radiator adds warmth and a sleek visual accent. Natural light floods the space through a UPVC-framed double-glazed sash window, highlighting the tiled floor, which completes the sophisticated and serene aesthetic. Every detail has been carefully considered to create a tranquil and stylish bathroom that offers the feeling of a high-end spa within the comfort of home.

EXTERNALLY To the side of the property lies a secluded and enchanting garden, predominantly laid to lush lawn and beautifully planted with a variety of mature trees, shrubs, and seasonal planting, creating a sense of privacy and tranquility. This verdant space provides a serene retreat, perfect for outdoor relaxation, alfresco dining, or enjoying the surrounding countryside. A designated parking area ensures convenient off-road parking, while an oil storage tank is discreetly positioned to blend seamlessly into the surroundings. The property also benefits from shared pedestrian and vehicle access to the front of Annum Barn, offering practicality without compromising the sense of seclusion. This side garden perfectly complements the character and charm of the barn conversion, enhancing both lifestyle and visual appeal.
